claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these cloths as excellent makeup removers, often working with just water and outperforming Norwex.
Many reviewers find the cloths very soft and plush, though some note they can feel rough if not fully saturated with water.
Several reviewers highlight the value, noting they are cheaper than alternatives like Norwex or the Beauty Eraser while being just as effective.
A few reviewers mention a chemical smell upon arrival or sensitivity/allergy concerns, including one esthetician with chemical sensitivities who does not recommend them.
Some reviewers note difficulty distinguishing the exfoliating side from the cleansing side, and one found tugging too hard when removing makeup.
